page.layout: Two columns of dictionary entries side by side, separated by a central rule. Left column: entries from שׁוּבִינוּ to שׂוּכָה ramus suus, pro. Right column: continuation from שׂוּכוֹ to clamor meus, vociferari. Below the right column: the signature "Eee" at left and a Hebrew catchword at right. Printed page number 401 at top right. Running head at top of each column in Hebrew.

main_text.l: שׁוּבִינוּ converte nos , Ps. 85. 5. pro שׁוּבֵנוּ , Imper. Kal, f. m. aff. Rad. שׁוּב .

שׁוּטְטוּ percurrerunt, præt. Piel, 3. pl. R. שׁוּט .
בְּשׁוּטִים scuticis, pl. m. præf. No. שׁוֹט ; Rad. שׁוּט itare.
שׁוִּתִּי proponebam, præt. Piel, 1. f. R. שׁוָּה .

שׂוּכוֹ, No. f. m. שׂוּךְ, aff. vel pro שׂוּכָתוֹ, שׂוּכָה, aff. Rad. שׂוּךְ sepivit.
שׂוֹכְנִי habitans, Deut. 33. 16. pro שׁוֹכֵן, Part. Ben. Kal, f. m. parag. Rad. שָׁכַן .
שׂוּכָה ramus, f. fæm. constr. No. שׂוּכָה ; Rad. שׂוּךְ, vel שׂוּךְ sepivit.

שׂוּמָה positio, 2. Sam.13. 32. No. sing. fæm. Rad. שׂוּם ponere.
הַשּׂוּמִים allia, pl. m. præf. No. Rad. שׂוּם .

שֵׁיעַ clamor meus, No. f. m. שִׁיעַ, aff. R. שָׁעַע vociferari.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and consonants are copied as far as they could be read at this scan resolution; the Hebrew entries throughout are uncertain in their pointing and should be checked against a clearer scan. The running head letters at top are read as Hebrew shin and vav and are uncertain. The Hebrew catchword at bottom right is read approximately. The Hebrew root in the entry conculcantes nos is doubtful. The lines are printed as dictionary entries, so each is a single line element; the column break runs from the last left line "ramus suus, pro" into the first right line.
